summary: Close Telegram sessions through explicit lifecycle events
description: Map Telegram reset, topic close/delete, resume, normal gateway shutdown and lease expiry to truthful session, routing and lease state without deleting transcripts.
acceptance: R1 reset closes the old session before creating the next; R2 topic close/delete removes or suspends routing and preserves transcript; R3 shutdown releases leases and crash relies on expiry; R4 end_reason values are explicit and stable; R5 Telegram lifecycle E2E tests prove reopen/resume behavior.
